landing.headline: Learn mathematics
landing.description: Master graph theory, numerical methods and optimization problems through hands-on exercises and instant feedback.

graphTheory.name: Graph Theory
graphTheory.desc: Explore networks, paths, and structures that model real-world systems — from logistics routing to social networks and circuit design.

numericalMethods.name: Numerical Methods
numericalMethods.desc: Solve equations without closed-form solutions. Learn approximation algorithms used in engineering and scientific computing.

optimization.name: Optimization
optimization.desc: Find optimal solutions among many candidates. From linear programming to gradient-based methods in operations research and ML.

purpose.title: Practical mathematics for real problems
purpose.desc: Stop memorising formulas without context. Progenesis teaches applied mathematical methods you can actually use — grounded in theory, reinforced through practice.

howItWorks.title: Learn by doing
howItWorks.s1desc: Work through structured lessons with interactive examples, graphs, and LaTeX-rendered formulas.
howItWorks.s2desc: Complete auto-graded tests with hints. Immediate feedback tells you exactly where you stand.
howItWorks.s3desc: Pass a course and receive a results certificate showing your score — proof of your new applied skills.

cert.title: Earn a certificate when you complete a course
cert.desc: Every course you finish comes with a results certificate. Pass all required tests and your score is recorded — documented proof of your applied mathematics skills.
cert.p2: Includes your score and percentage breakdown
cert.p3: Reflects real problem-solving ability, not just attendance

ai.title: Recommendations tailored to your progress
ai.desc: After completing tests, our AI analyzes your performance across all topics — identifying strengths, weak spots, and the most impactful next steps.
ai.p1: Analyzes your answers and score patterns
ai.p2: Highlights exactly which topics need more practice
ai.p3: Suggests prioritized actions to improve fastest
ai.mockRecText: Focus on network flow problems — especially Ford-Fulkerson. Review the max-flow min-cut theorem before your next attempt.

cta.title: Ready to start learning?
cta.desc: Join the platform and start building practical mathematics skills today.
